SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean("counter"), 10s) * 8 / 10 / 1000000 
AS "Ethernet_traffic"
FROM "ifInOctets"
WHERE "url" =~ /target=10\.244\.1\.86/ 
AND "ifName" =~ /Ethernet(2|3|4|5)/ 
AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY time(10s), "ifName" fill(null)
